scope: Four PostgreSQL TCP disconnection tests, evaluation worksheet, and engineering documentation. No business implementation, API contract, prompt, or candidate label changes.
environment: macOS; Python 3.11; isolated livingmind-eval PostgreSQL; HTTP persistent virtual gateway

related_recovery_mixed.note: SQL-specific fixtures use SQL; general service tests use memory

related_recovery_sql.note: All service tests use SQL storage

preserved_failure.cause: New fixture's monkeypatch teardown restored a SQL URL after outer fixture cleanup, leaking state into a later test. Replaced with explicitly ordered config restoration; no assertion weakened.

checks: Unknown and lease preserved on pre-commit disconnection
Terminal status and one activity preserved after commit
Recovery process survives disconnection and resumes without restart
limitations: Connection close/rejection, not silent packet loss
Only recovery worker database transport, not all API network partitions
No new model calls, quality scores, or latency improvement claim
